		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_close = global.cw_oly_base }

		add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_w_day_0 = 24159 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_year_0 = 2040 } }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_s_day_0 = global.cw_oly_base }
		add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_s_day_0 = 25788 }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_w_day_0 = global.cw_oly_base }
		add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_w_day_0 = 25620 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_s_day_0 = 2922 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_w_day_0 = 2922 }
	}
}

# Values of the next Summer Games (slot global.cw_oly_cur) for decisions and triggers.
cw_oly_refresh_cur = {
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_next_host_known
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_cur = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_next_year = global.cw_oly_year_0 }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_prog_close = global.cw_oly_s_day_0 }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_boy_close = global.cw_oly_s_day_0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_0 }
			set_variable = { global.cw_oly_next_host = global.cw_oly_s_host_0 }
			set_global_flag = cw_oly_next_host_known
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_next_year = global.cw_oly_year_1 }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_prog_close = global.cw_oly_s_day_1 }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_boy_close = global.cw_oly_s_day_1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_1 }
			set_variable = { global.cw_oly_next_host = global.cw_oly_s_host_1 }
			set_global_flag = cw_oly_next_host_known
		}
	}
	subtract_from_variable = { global.cw_oly_prog_close = 90 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.cw_oly_boy_close = 30 }
}

# Runs once per month (gated in the on_action). Only date comparisons; work happens at the dates.
cw_oly_global_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cw_oly_bid_scheduled
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_bidding }
			check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = global.cw_oly_bid_open compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cw_oly_bid_close }
		}
		cw_oly_open_bidding = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cw_oly_bid_scheduled
			check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = global.cw_oly_bid_close compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		cw_oly_close_bidding = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cw_oly_w_pending_0
			check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = global.cw_oly_w_day_0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		cw_oly_run_winter_0 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_pending_0
			check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = global.cw_oly_s_day_0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		cw_oly_run_summer_0 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cw_oly_w_pending_1
			check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = global.cw_oly_w_day_1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		cw_oly_run_winter_1 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_pending_1
			check_variable = { var = global.num_days value = global.cw_oly_s_day_1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		cw_oly_run_summer_1 = yes
	}
}

cw_oly_open_bidding = {
	set_global_flag = cw_oly_bidding
	clear_array = global.cw_oly_s_bidders
	clear_array = global.cw_oly_w_bidders
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OLY.1 }
	}
}

cw_oly_close_bidding = {
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_bidding
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_bid_scheduled
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_s_bid_n = global.cw_oly_s_bidders^num }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_w_bid_n = global.cw_oly_w_bidders^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_slot = 0 } }
		cw_oly_award_0 = yes
	}
	else = {
		cw_oly_award_1 = yes
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = cw_oly_bid_s
				has_country_flag = cw_oly_bid_w
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_bid_s
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_bid_w
	}
	clear_array = global.cw_oly_s_bidders
	clear_array = global.cw_oly_w_bidders
	add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 4 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_slot = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_slot = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_slot = 0 }
	}
	cw_oly_schedule_bid = yes
}

cw_oly_take_s_0 = {
	set_country_flag = cw_oly_host_s_0
	set_variable = { cw_oly_ready_s_0 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_s_host_0 = THIS }
	set_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_0
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_ready_s_0 = 3 }
		set_country_flag = cw_oly_built_s_0_stadium
		set_country_flag = cw_oly_built_s_0_village
		set_country_flag = cw_oly_built_s_0_transit
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0150 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OLY.4 days = 1 }
	}
}

cw_oly_take_w_0 = {
	set_country_flag = cw_oly_host_w_0
	set_variable = { cw_oly_ready_w_0 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_w_host_0 = THIS }
	set_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_0
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_ready_w_0 = 1 }
		set_country_flag = cw_oly_built_w_0_venues
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0040 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OLY.4 days = 1 }
	}
}

cw_oly_award_0 = {
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_year_0 = global.cw_oly_bid_year }
	cw_oly_schedule_games_0 = yes
	set_global_flag = cw_oly_s_pending_0
	set_global_flag = cw_oly_w_pending_0
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_0
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_0
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_s_by_lot
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_w_by_lot
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_s_bidders^num > 0 } }
		random_scope_in_array = {
			array = global.cw_oly_s_bidders
			limit = { exists = yes has_war = no }
			cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_0 }
		set_global_flag = cw_oly_s_by_lot
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1976 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = CAN CAN = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } CAN = { cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } SOV = { cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1980 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } SOV = { cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1984 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1988 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = KOR KOR = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } KOR = { cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = JAP JAP = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } JAP = { cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_0 } }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					has_war = no
					check_variable = { cw_oly_os_s > 9 }
				}
				cw_oly_take_s_0 = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_w_bidders^num > 0 } }
		random_scope_in_array = {
			array = global.cw_oly_w_bidders
			limit = { exists = yes has_war = no }
			cw_oly_take_w_0 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_0 }
		set_global_flag = cw_oly_w_by_lot
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1976 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = AUS AUS = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } AUS = { cw_oly_take_w_0 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_w_0 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1980 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_w_0 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1984 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = SER SER = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } SER = { cw_oly_take_w_0 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1988 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = CAN CAN = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } CAN = { cw_oly_take_w_0 = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_0 } }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					has_war = no
					check_variable = { cw_oly_os_w > 7 }
				}
				cw_oly_take_w_0 = yes
			}
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_v_year = global.cw_oly_year_0 }
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_s
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_w
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_0 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_host = global.cw_oly_s_host_0 }
			set_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_s
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_0 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_whost = global.cw_oly_w_host_0 }
			set_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_w
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OLY.2 }
	}
}

	set_variable = { cw_oly_ready_s_1 = 0 }

	set_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_1

cw_oly_award_1 = {
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_year_1 = global.cw_oly_bid_year }
	cw_oly_schedule_games_1 = yes
	set_global_flag = cw_oly_s_pending_1
	set_global_flag = cw_oly_w_pending_1
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_1
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_1
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_s_by_lot
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_w_by_lot
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_s_bidders^num > 0 } }
		random_scope_in_array = {
			array = global.cw_oly_s_bidders
			limit = { exists = yes has_war = no }
			cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_1 }
		set_global_flag = cw_oly_s_by_lot
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1976 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = CAN CAN = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } CAN = { cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } SOV = { cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1980 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } SOV = { cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1984 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1988 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = KOR KOR = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } KOR = { cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = JAP JAP = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } JAP = { cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_1 } }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					has_war = no
					check_variable = { cw_oly_os_s > 9 }
				}
				cw_oly_take_s_1 = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_w_bidders^num > 0 } }
		random_scope_in_array = {
			array = global.cw_oly_w_bidders
			limit = { exists = yes has_war = no }
			cw_oly_take_w_1 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_1 }
		set_global_flag = cw_oly_w_by_lot
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1976 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = AUS AUS = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } AUS = { cw_oly_take_w_1 = yes } }
			else_if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_w_1 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1980 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } USA = { cw_oly_take_w_1 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1984 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = SER SER = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } SER = { cw_oly_take_w_1 = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_bid_year = 1988 } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = CAN CAN = { is_ai = yes has_war = no } } CAN = { cw_oly_take_w_1 = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_1 } }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					has_war = no
					check_variable = { cw_oly_os_w > 7 }
				}
				cw_oly_take_w_1 = yes
			}
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_v_year = global.cw_oly_year_1 }
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_s
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_w
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_1 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_host = global.cw_oly_s_host_1 }
			set_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_s
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_1 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_whost = global.cw_oly_w_host_1 }
			set_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_w
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OLY.2 }
	}
}

cw_oly_edu_tier = {
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_edu = 3 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = edu_01 } set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_edu = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = edu_02 } set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_edu = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = edu_04 } set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_edu = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = edu_05 } set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_edu = 5 } }
}

# Real GDP per capita (deflated with the Cold War US price index when it exists).
cw_oly_real_gdppc = {
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_g = gdp_per_capita }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi > 0 } }
		divide_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_g = global.mdcw_cw_cpi }
	}
}

# A country's own starting point; later Games compare against it.
cw_oly_snapshot = {
	set_country_flag = cw_oly_base_set
	cw_oly_edu_tier = yes
	set_variable = { cw_oly_edu70 = cw_oly_t_edu }
	set_variable = { cw_oly_stab70 = stability }
	cw_oly_real_gdppc = yes
	set_variable = { cw_oly_gdppc70 = cw_oly_t_g }
}

# Country scope. Temp cw_oly_t_summer = 1 for Summer, 0 for Winter. Sets cw_oly_score.
cw_oly_score = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cw_oly_base_set } }
		cw_oly_snapshot = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_m = 1 }

	cw_oly_edu_tier = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = cw_oly_t_edu }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = cw_oly_edu70 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = 0.05 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cw_oly_t_d min = -0.15 max = 0.15 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_m = cw_oly_t_d }

	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = stability }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = cw_oly_stab70 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = 0.5 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cw_oly_t_d min = -0.15 max = 0.15 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_m = cw_oly_t_d }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cw_oly_gdppc70 > 0 } }
		cw_oly_real_gdppc = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = cw_oly_t_g }
		divide_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = cw_oly_gdppc70 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = 1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = 0.3 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cw_oly_t_d min = -0.15 max = 0.15 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_m = cw_oly_t_d }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = cw_oly_prog }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cw_oly_t_summer = 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = 0.10 }
	}
	else = {
		multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_d = 0.05 }
	}
	add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_m = cw_oly_t_d }

	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cw_oly_host_now }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_m = 0.30 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cw_oly_t_summer = 1 }
			has_country_flag = cw_oly_doping
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_m = 0.20 }
		set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_c = 0.20 }
		if = {
			limit = { cw_oly_opposes_next_host = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_c = 0.10 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_f = cw_oly_dope_finds }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_f = 0.05 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_c = cw_oly_t_f }
		set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_r = random }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw_oly_t_r < cw_oly_t_c } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_caught_now days = 30 value = 1 }
		}
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cw_oly_t_m min = 0.4 max = 2.0 }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cw_oly_t_summer = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_os = cw_oly_os_s }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cw_oly_t_os min = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_os = cw_oly_os_w }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cw_oly_t_os min = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cw_oly_score = cw_oly_t_os }
	multiply_variable = { cw_oly_score = cw_oly_t_m }
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_r = random }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_r = 0.3 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_r = 0.85 }
	multiply_variable = { cw_oly_score = cw_oly_t_r }
}

# Adds THIS to the field (temp arrays cw_oly_nats / cw_oly_vals).
cw_oly_enter_field = {
	add_to_temp_array = { cw_oly_vals = cw_oly_score }
	add_to_temp_array = { cw_oly_nats = THIS }
	add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_sum = cw_oly_score }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cw_oly_score > global.cw_oly_max } }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_max = cw_oly_score }
	}
}

cw_oly_reset_field = {
	clear_array = global.cw_oly_rank
	clear_array = global.cw_oly_rank_g
	clear_array = global.cw_oly_rank_s
	clear_array = global.cw_oly_rank_b
	clear_array = global.cw_oly_caught
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_sum = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_max = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_points = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_boy_n = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_variable = cw_oly_rank }
		clear_variable = cw_oly_rank
		clear_variable = cw_oly_g
		clear_variable = cw_oly_s
		clear_variable = cw_oly_b
	}
}

# Sort the field, hand out medals (pool global.cw_oly_pool, rest of world global.cw_oly_row).
cw_oly_sort_and_medals = {
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_end = cw_oly_vals^num }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n = cw_oly_t_end }
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_den = global.cw_oly_sum }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_den = global.cw_oly_row }
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_pos = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		end = cw_oly_t_end

		find_highest_in_array = {
			array = cw_oly_vals
			value = cw_oly_t_hv
			index = cw_oly_t_hi
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_nat = cw_oly_nats^cw_oly_t_hi }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_pos = 1 }
		var:cw_oly_t_nat = {
			set_variable = { cw_oly_rank = cw_oly_t_pos }
			set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_med = cw_oly_score }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_med = global.cw_oly_pool }
			divide_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_med = cw_oly_t_den }
			set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_gs = cw_oly_score }
			divide_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_gs = global.cw_oly_max }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_gs = 0.18 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_gs = 0.22 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_g = cw_oly_t_med }
			multiply_variable = { cw_oly_g = cw_oly_t_gs }
			round_variable = cw_oly_g
			set_variable = { cw_oly_s = cw_oly_t_med }
			multiply_variable = { cw_oly_s = 0.33 }
			round_variable = cw_oly_s
			set_variable = { cw_oly_b = cw_oly_t_med }
			round_variable = cw_oly_b
			subtract_from_variable = { cw_oly_b = cw_oly_g }
			subtract_from_variable = { cw_oly_b = cw_oly_s }
			clamp_variable = { var = cw_oly_b min = 0 }
			add_to_array = { global.cw_oly_rank = THIS }
			add_to_array = { global.cw_oly_rank_g = cw_oly_g }
			add_to_array = { global.cw_oly_rank_s = cw_oly_s }
			add_to_array = { global.cw_oly_rank_b = cw_oly_b }
		}
		remove_from_temp_array = { array = cw_oly_nats index = cw_oly_t_hi }
		remove_from_temp_array = { array = cw_oly_vals index = cw_oly_t_hi }
	}
}

cw_oly_compute_summer = {
	cw_oly_reset_field = yes
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_pool = 640 }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_row = 40 }
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_summer = 1 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { cw_oly_os_s > 0 }
				is_ai = no
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cw_oly_boycott }
			add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_boy_n = 1 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_st_boy days = 30 value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cw_oly_banned }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_st_ban days = 30 value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			cw_oly_score = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cw_oly_caught_now }
				add_to_array = { global.cw_oly_caught = THIS }
			}
			else = {
				cw_oly_enter_field = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_points = cw_oly_prog }
			}
		}
	}
	cw_oly_sort_and_medals = yes
}

cw_oly_compute_winter = {
	cw_oly_reset_field = yes
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_pool = 120 }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_row = 5 }
	set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_summer = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { cw_oly_os_w > 0 }
				AND = {
					is_ai = no
					check_variable = { cw_oly_prog > 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		cw_oly_score = yes
		cw_oly_enter_field = yes
	}
	cw_oly_sort_and_medals = yes
}

cw_oly_rewards_summer = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_idea = cw_oly_champions
				has_idea = cw_oly_superpower
				has_idea = cw_oly_medal_nation
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_idea = cw_oly_champions } remove_ideas = cw_oly_champions }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = cw_oly_superpower } remove_ideas = cw_oly_superpower }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = cw_oly_medal_nation } remove_ideas = cw_oly_medal_nation }
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes } }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cw_oly_rank
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw_oly_rank = 1 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = cw_oly_champions days = 1460 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_got_r1 days = 30 value = 1 }
			hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw_oly_rank < 4 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = cw_oly_superpower days = 1460 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_got_r2 days = 30 value = 1 }
			hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw_oly_rank < 11 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = cw_oly_medal_nation days = 1460 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_got_r3 days = 30 value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Ends the Olympiad: programmes, doping, boycotts and old bans expire; new doping cases are banned.
cw_oly_cleanup_summer = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { cw_oly_prog > 0 }
				has_country_flag = cw_oly_doping
				has_country_flag = cw_oly_boycott
				has_country_flag = cw_oly_banned
			}
		}
		set_variable = { cw_oly_prog = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = cw_oly_preparation_1 } remove_ideas = cw_oly_preparation_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = cw_oly_preparation_2 } remove_ideas = cw_oly_preparation_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = cw_oly_preparation_3 } remove_ideas = cw_oly_preparation_3 }
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_doping
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_boycott
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_banned
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_called_boycott
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cw_oly_caught
		set_country_flag = cw_oly_banned
		add_to_variable = { cw_oly_dope_finds = 1 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = cw_oly_doping_scandal days = 730 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_got_dope days = 30 value = 1 }
	}
}

# Host scope (cw_oly_host_now). global.cw_oly_t_ready = readiness 0..3.
cw_oly_host_rewards_summer = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_t_ready > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_q = global.cw_oly_t_ready }
		divide_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_q = 3 }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_legacy_tax = global.cw_oly_points }
		multiply_variable = { cw_oly_legacy_tax = 0.004 }
		add_to_variable = { cw_oly_legacy_tax = 0.02 }
		clamp_variable = { var = cw_oly_legacy_tax max = 0.10 }
		multiply_variable = { cw_oly_legacy_tax = cw_oly_t_q }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_fever_stab = global.cw_oly_t_ready }
		multiply_variable = { cw_oly_fever_stab = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { cw_oly_fever_stab = 0.03 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cw_oly_legacy_modifier days = 3650 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cw_oly_fever_modifier days = 730 }
		set_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_cp = cw_oly_t_q }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cw_oly_t_cp = 0.15 }
		capital_scope = {
			set_variable = { cw_oly_city_prod = cw_oly_t_cp }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cw_oly_city_modifier days = 3650 }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_got_host days = 30 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		add_timed_idea = { idea = cw_oly_white_elephant days = 730 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_got_elephant days = 30 value = 1 }
	}
}

cw_oly_rewards_winter = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_idea = cw_oly_winter_champions }
		remove_ideas = cw_oly_winter_champions
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cw_oly_rank
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw_oly_rank = 1 } }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = cw_oly_winter_champions days = 730 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_got_w1 days = 30 value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cw_oly_host_rewards_winter = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_t_ready > 0 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cw_oly_winter_legacy_modifier days = 1825 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = cw_oly_winter_fever days = 365 }
		capital_scope = {
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cw_oly_winter_city_modifier days = 1825 }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_got_whost days = 30 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		add_timed_idea = { idea = cw_oly_white_elephant days = 365 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = cw_oly_got_elephant days = 30 value = 1 }
	}
}

cw_oly_publish_summer = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_v_n = global.cw_oly_rank_n }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_v_year = global.cw_oly_res_year }
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_host
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_res_has_host }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_host = global.cw_oly_res_host }
			set_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_host
		}
		set_variable = { cw_oly_v_boy_n = global.cw_oly_boy_n }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_v_dope_n = global.cw_oly_caught^num }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_caught^num > 0 } } set_variable = { cw_oly_v_dope1 = global.cw_oly_caught^0 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_caught^num > 1 } } set_variable = { cw_oly_v_dope2 = global.cw_oly_caught^1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r1 = global.cw_oly_rank^0 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g1 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^0 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s1 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^0 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b1 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 1 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r2 = global.cw_oly_rank^1 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g2 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^1 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s2 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^1 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b2 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 2 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r3 = global.cw_oly_rank^2 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g3 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^2 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s3 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^2 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b3 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 3 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r4 = global.cw_oly_rank^3 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g4 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^3 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s4 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^3 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b4 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 4 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r5 = global.cw_oly_rank^4 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g5 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^4 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s5 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^4 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b5 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 5 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r6 = global.cw_oly_rank^5 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g6 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^5 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s6 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^5 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b6 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 6 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r7 = global.cw_oly_rank^6 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g7 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^6 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s7 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^6 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b7 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 7 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r8 = global.cw_oly_rank^7 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g8 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^7 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s8 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^7 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b8 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 8 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r9 = global.cw_oly_rank^8 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g9 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^8 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s9 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^8 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b9 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 9 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r10 = global.cw_oly_rank^9 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g10 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^9 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s10 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^9 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b10 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^9 }
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OLY.10 }
	}
}

cw_oly_publish_winter = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_v_n = global.cw_oly_rank_n }
		set_variable = { cw_oly_v_year = global.cw_oly_res_year }
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_host
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_res_has_host }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_host = global.cw_oly_res_host }
			set_country_flag = cw_oly_v_has_host
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r1 = global.cw_oly_rank^0 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g1 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^0 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s1 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^0 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b1 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 1 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r2 = global.cw_oly_rank^1 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g2 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^1 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s2 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^1 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b2 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 2 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r3 = global.cw_oly_rank^2 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g3 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^2 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s3 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^2 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b3 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 3 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r4 = global.cw_oly_rank^3 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g4 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^3 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s4 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^3 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b4 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 4 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r5 = global.cw_oly_rank^4 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g5 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^4 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s5 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^4 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b5 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 5 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r6 = global.cw_oly_rank^5 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g6 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^5 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s6 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^5 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b6 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 6 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r7 = global.cw_oly_rank^6 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g7 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^6 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s7 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^6 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b7 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 7 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r8 = global.cw_oly_rank^7 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g8 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^7 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s8 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^7 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b8 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 8 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r9 = global.cw_oly_rank^8 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g9 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^8 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s9 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^8 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b9 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_rank_n > 9 } }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_r10 = global.cw_oly_rank^9 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_g10 = global.cw_oly_rank_g^9 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_s10 = global.cw_oly_rank_s^9 }
			set_variable = { cw_oly_v_b10 = global.cw_oly_rank_b^9 }
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OLY.11 }
	}
}

cw_oly_run_summer_0 = {
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_s_pending_0
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_res_year = global.cw_oly_year_0 }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_t_ready = 0 }
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_res_has_host
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_0 }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_res_host = global.cw_oly_s_host_0 }
		set_global_flag = cw_oly_res_has_host
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cw_oly_host_s_0 }
		set_country_flag = cw_oly_host_now
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_t_ready = cw_oly_ready_s_0 }
	}
	cw_oly_compute_summer = yes
	cw_oly_rewards_summer = yes
	cw_oly_cleanup_summer = yes
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_cur = 1 }
	cw_oly_refresh_cur = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cw_oly_host_now }
		cw_oly_host_rewards_summer = yes
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_host_now
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_host_s_0
	}
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_s_host_known_0
	cw_oly_publish_summer = yes
}

cw_oly_run_winter_0 = {
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_w_pending_0
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_res_year = global.cw_oly_year_0 }
	set_variable = { global.cw_oly_t_ready = 0 }
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_res_has_host
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_0 }
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_res_host = global.cw_oly_w_host_0 }
		set_global_flag = cw_oly_res_has_host
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cw_oly_host_w_0 }
		set_country_flag = cw_oly_host_now
		set_variable = { global.cw_oly_t_ready = cw_oly_ready_w_0 }
	}
	cw_oly_compute_winter = yes
	cw_oly_rewards_winter = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cw_oly_host_now }
		cw_oly_host_rewards_winter = yes
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_host_now
		clr_country_flag = cw_oly_host_w_0
	}
	clr_global_flag = cw_oly_w_host_known_0
	cw_oly_publish_winter = yes
}

cw_oly_boycott_tension = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_oly_tension_p1_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tension }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 1 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
		}
	}
}
